# Quilliam AI
> AI consulting, training and implementation for UK businesses

> Full version: https://quilliam.ai/llms-full.txt
> Last updated: 2026-08-13

## About
Quilliam AI is the trading name of Quilliam AI Ltd (UK Companies House number 17151006, incorporated on 2026-04-11, with its registered office in Cornwall, England). Levi Quilliam founded the company to provide AI assessment, staff training and implementation services to UK businesses.

## Approach
Quilliam AI reviews recurring business processes, system dependencies, data, risk and staff responsibilities. Where AI is suitable, the company defines the scope, implements the agreed workflow or supervised agent, applies appropriate controls, tests representative cases and trains the responsible staff. Documentation and handover requirements are agreed before paid work begins.

## Services
- AI Opportunity Analysis: a prioritised assessment of suitable AI uses, required preparation, risks, controls and the proposed first project.
- Team Training: role-specific staff training covering permitted use, prompts, review procedures, privacy and internal policies.
- AI Implementation: workflows, automations, supervised agents, knowledge systems and internal tools for defined business processes.

## Case Study
VetVision AI is a University of Nottingham spin-out that uses camera systems to monitor animal welfare in equine and dairy environments. Quilliam AI has supported product presentation, search content, a branded onboarding portal, farm and camera operations workflows, and internal AI implementation. Reported outcomes include an approximate SEO score change from 40 to 95 and increases in website visibility, visitor numbers and enquiries.

## Delivery Process
1. Assess current processes, recurring work, systems, data, risk and ownership.
2. Define the first project, including scope, controls, responsibilities and success measures.
3. Implement and test the agreed system against representative cases.
4. Train the responsible staff and provide the agreed handover documents.

## Budget Guidance
Quilliam AI quotes against an agreed scope. Training usually starts from £500. Small implementation projects may cost approximately £2,000 to £3,000. Medium projects may range from £5,000 to £50,000. Larger programmes are usually above £50,000. A written scope and fee are provided before paid work begins.
